# World Documentation

- [World Developer Docs](https://docs.world.org/index.md): Build Mini Apps, integrate World ID, and deploy on World Chain with official developer documentation.
- [Overview](https://docs.world.org/world-id/overview.md)
- [IDKit](https://docs.world.org/world-id/idkit/integrate.md): Integrate World ID into your app
- [Verification Flows](https://docs.world.org/world-id/idkit/verification-flows.md): The flows your integration can land users in when you request a World ID proof.
- [Configure Credentials](https://docs.world.org/world-id/idkit/credentials.md)
- [Mini Apps](https://docs.world.org/world-id/idkit/mini-apps.md)
- [RP Signatures](https://docs.world.org/world-id/idkit/signatures.md): Spec for generating RP signatures, with pseudocode, SDK examples, and test vectors.
- [Build with LLMs](https://docs.world.org/world-id/idkit/build-with-llms.md)
- [On-chain Verification](https://docs.world.org/world-id/idkit/onchain-verification.md): Verify World ID proofs directly in Solidity for web3-native flows.
- [Design Guidelines](https://docs.world.org/world-id/idkit/design-guidelines.md)
- [JavaScript](https://docs.world.org/world-id/idkit/javascript.md): Reference for `@worldcoin/idkit-core`
- [React](https://docs.world.org/world-id/idkit/react.md): Reference for @worldcoin/idkit React widgets and hooks, including request flows and presets.
- [Swift](https://docs.world.org/world-id/idkit/swift.md): Reference for the IDKit Swift API: request builders, presets, and polling.
- [Kotlin](https://docs.world.org/world-id/idkit/kotlin.md): Reference for the IDKit Kotlin API: request builders, presets, and polling.
- [Go](https://docs.world.org/world-id/idkit/go.md): Lightweight Go module for generating RP signatures.
- [Error Codes](https://docs.world.org/world-id/idkit/error-codes.md): Reference for IDKit request error codes and handling guidance across JS, React, Kotlin, and Swift.
- [What is Sandbox?](https://docs.world.org/world-id/sandbox/what-is-sandbox.md): An isolated, production-like environment for testing your World ID integration end-to-end.
- [How to get access](https://docs.world.org/world-id/sandbox/sandbox-access.md): Install the sandbox World ID app and point your integration at the Sandbox environment.
- [Testing Selfie Check (Beta) in Sandbox](https://docs.world.org/world-id/sandbox/testing-selfie-check.md): Coverage, critical user journeys, and known limitations for testing your Selfie Check (Beta) integration in Sandbox.
- [Proof of Human (PoH)](https://docs.world.org/world-id/credentials/1.md): High assurance biometric credential captured by the Orb and used for uniqueness.
- [NFC Credential](https://docs.world.org/world-id/credentials/9303.md): A unique government-issued document, such as a passport or eID.
- [Selfie Check (Beta)](https://docs.world.org/world-id/credentials/11.md): A medium-assurance biometric credential using the device camera for liveness and facial similarity.
- [World ID 4.0](https://docs.world.org/world-id/4-0-migration.md): Migration guide for moving your app to World ID 4.0
- [IDKit Standalone](https://docs.world.org/world-id/from-idkit-standalone.md): Migrate from @worldcoin/idkit-standalone to @worldcoin/idkit-core.
- [Core Concepts](https://docs.world.org/world-id/concepts.md): Minimal concepts and vocabulary for integrating World ID.
- [Authenticator Reference](https://docs.world.org/world-id/reference/authenticator.md)
- [Get Inclusion Proof](https://docs.world.org/api-reference/indexer/get-inclusion-proof.md): Returns a Merkle inclusion proof for the given leaf index to the current `WorldIDRegistry` tree. In addition, it also includes the entire authenticator slot list for the World ID account. Removed authenticators are represented as `null` entries to preserve `pubkey_id` positions.
- [Get Packed Account Data](https://docs.world.org/api-reference/indexer/get-packed-account-data.md): Returns the packed account data for a given authenticator address from the `WorldIDRegistry` contract.
- [Get Signature Nonce](https://docs.world.org/api-reference/indexer/get-signature-nonce.md): Returns the current signature nonce for a given World ID based on its leaf index. The nonce is used to perform on-chain operations for the World ID.
- [Get Authenticator Pubkeys](https://docs.world.org/api-reference/indexer/get-authenticator-pubkeys.md): Returns the compressed authenticator public keys for a given World ID by leaf index. Removed authenticator slots are returned as `null` to preserve `pubkey_id` positions.
- [Post create account](https://docs.world.org/api-reference/gateway/post-create-account.md)
- [Post insert authenticator](https://docs.world.org/api-reference/gateway/post-insert-authenticator.md)
- [Post update authenticator](https://docs.world.org/api-reference/gateway/post-update-authenticator.md)
- [Post remove authenticator](https://docs.world.org/api-reference/gateway/post-remove-authenticator.md)
- [Post recover account](https://docs.world.org/api-reference/gateway/post-recover-account.md)
- [Get is valid root](https://docs.world.org/api-reference/gateway/get-is-valid-root.md)
- [Get status](https://docs.world.org/api-reference/gateway/get-status.md)
- [PoH Issuer](https://docs.world.org/world-id/reference/poh-issuer.md): PoH issuer endpoints, including credential refresh for v3 to v4 migration.
- [NFC Issuer](https://docs.world.org/world-id/reference/nfc-issuer.md): NFC issuer endpoints, including migration for World ID v3 NFC credentials.
- [Contracts 3.0](https://docs.world.org/world-id/reference/contracts.md): World ID 3.0 smart contracts overview: supported chains, architecture, World ID Router verifyProof, and sybil resistance.
- [What are Mini Apps?](https://docs.world.org/mini-apps/index.md): Learn what Mini Apps are and how to build native-like apps in World App with MiniKit, distribution and monetization.
- [Getting Started](https://docs.world.org/mini-apps/quick-start/installing.md): Create a Mini App with the official template or install MiniKit-JS manually.
- [Initialization](https://docs.world.org/mini-apps/quick-start/init.md)
- [Commands](https://docs.world.org/mini-apps/quick-start/commands.md): Overview of current MiniKit commands for mini apps.

- [Testing your mini app](https://docs.world.org/mini-apps/quick-start/testing.md): Enter your App ID and scan the generated QR code to test your mini app.
- [Mini App Store](https://docs.world.org/mini-apps/quick-start/app-store.md): Submit your Mini App for review and distribution in World App; follow guidelines and resolve rejections.

- [World ID](https://docs.world.org/mini-apps/commands/verify.md): World ID verification has moved to IDKit.
- [Pay](https://docs.world.org/mini-apps/commands/pay.md): Request a payment from the user
- [Wallet Authentication](https://docs.world.org/mini-apps/commands/wallet-auth.md): Authenticate a user with Sign-In with Ethereum using the unified MiniKit API.
- [Send Transaction](https://docs.world.org/mini-apps/commands/send-transaction.md): Send one or more World Chain transactions using the unified MiniKit API.

- [Sign Message](https://docs.world.org/mini-apps/commands/sign-message.md): Sign an EIP-191 message using the unified MiniKit API.
- [Sign Typed Data](https://docs.world.org/mini-apps/commands/sign-typed-data.md): Sign EIP-712 typed data using the unified MiniKit API.
- [Share Contacts](https://docs.world.org/mini-apps/commands/share-contacts.md): Open the native contact picker using the unified MiniKit API.
- [Request Permission](https://docs.world.org/mini-apps/commands/request-permission.md): Request a mini app permission using the unified MiniKit API.

- [Verify](https://docs.world.org/api-reference/developer-portal/verify.md): Verifies World ID 4.0 proofs and legacy 3.0 proofs. Forward the complete IDKit result without remapping response identifiers or constructing a legacy `verification_level`. Use `rp_id` (`rp_...`) when possible; `app_id` (`app_...`) is still accepted for backward compatibility.
- [Verify (Legacy)](https://docs.world.org/api-reference/developer-portal/verify-legacy.md): Verify a World ID proof for a Cloud action.
- [Send Notification](https://docs.world.org/api-reference/developer-portal/send-notification.md): Send notifications to users of your mini app.
- [Get Transaction](https://docs.world.org/api-reference/developer-portal/get-transaction.md): Query transactions for their current status.
- [Get User Operation](https://docs.world.org/api-reference/developer-portal/get-user-operation.md): Query a MiniKit user operation by `userOpHash` and resolve the final on-chain transaction hash when it becomes available.
- [Get Transaction Debug URL](https://docs.world.org/api-reference/developer-portal/get-transaction-debug-url.md): Debug transactions that failed during the prepare stage. Returns Tenderly URLs when applicable.
- [Get User Grant Cycle](https://docs.world.org/api-reference/developer-portal/get-user-grant-cycle.md): Retrieve the next grant claim date for a user of your mini app. Returns the user's humanity (orb-verified) grant cycle date if available, otherwise falls back to their document (passport-verified) grant cycle date.
- [Get Prices](https://docs.world.org/api-reference/developer-portal/get-prices.md): Query latest prices of tokens in various fiat currencies.
- [MCP](https://docs.world.org/model-context-protocol/index.md): Connect AI assistants to World documentation and the World developer portal with Model Context Protocol servers.
- [World Docs MCP](https://docs.world.org/model-context-protocol/world-docs.md): Search World documentation from your AI coding assistant.
- [Developer Portal MCP](https://docs.world.org/model-context-protocol/developer-portal.md): Manage World developer portal apps from your AI coding assistant.
- [Smart Contract Development Guidelines](https://docs.world.org/mini-apps/guidelines/smart-contract-development-guidelines.md)
- [Credit Scoring API](https://docs.world.org/mini-apps/reference/credit-api.md): Real-time creditworthiness for World accounts. Look up by wallet address or World username to get borrower state and a credit score.
- [World Chat](https://docs.world.org/mini-apps/sharing/world-chat-qa.md)
- [Build with LLMs](https://docs.world.org/world-id/idkit/integration-prompt.md)
- [SKILL](https://docs.world.org/world-id/SKILL.md): Use this skill when adding, upgrading, debugging, or testing World ID verification with IDKit in a new or existing web or mobile app. Covers Proof of Human, passport/document, Selfie Check (Beta), and session/sign-in flows; Developer Portal app, RP, and action setup; server-side signing and proof ve…
